title: Self-Supervised Latent Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.37963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. translated_title: 面向时间序列的自监督潜在动作条件化世界建模
translated_abstract: 时间序列数据在天气预测、网络流量分析和语音识别等多种任务中发挥着重要作用。近年来，开创性的研究越来越多地采用基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的编码器，通过潜在空间预测来学习时间序列表示。然而，这些方法往往忽略了控制时间序列观测之间转移的潜在因素。在本工作中，我们假设显式建模时间序列变化背后的信息可以促进时间序列建模。基于这一假设，我们提出了ACTS-WM，一个用于时间序列分析的自监督潜在动作条件化世界模型框架。首先，我们引入了一种潜在动作建模方法，将时间序列转移背后的潜在信息推断为潜在动作，而无需显式的动作标注。随后，我们开发了一个基于JEPA的编码器和一个动作条件化的（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了ACTS-WM框架，一种自监督的潜在动作条件化世界模型，通过将时间序列转移背后的信息推断为潜在动作来改进时间序列建模，且无需显式的动作标注。
en_tdlr: Proposes ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework that improves time-series modeling by inferring the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations.
